user.title: Recipes
user.description: Pick the to-do list that ingredients are added to.

init.title: Recipes
init.description: Pick the to-do list that ingredients are added to.

save.name: Save recipe
save.description: Create a recipe, or update it when an ID is given (only the given fields change).

id.name: ID
id.description: ID of an existing recipe to update. Leave empty to create a new recipe.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Number of people the recipe is for.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: List of ingredients, each with amount, unit and name. The amount is a number (250, 0,5, 1/2, ½, 2-3) and is scaled; the unit is optional. Plain text lines also work: then only a number at the start becomes the amount.

photo_url.name: Photo URL
photo_url.description: Web address of a photo to download.

photo_base64.name: Photo (base64)
photo_base64.description: Photo as base64 text or data URL.

delete.name: Delete recipe
delete.description: Delete a recipe and its photo.

list.name: List recipes
list.description: Return all recipes with their ingredients and steps.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Put the ingredients of a recipe on the shopping list. Items that are already on the list are skipped.

title.name: Title
title.description: Name of the recipe (a unique part of the name is enough).

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Scale the amounts to this number of people.

only.name: Only
only.description: Only add ingredients that contain one of these words.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Skip ingredients that contain one of these words.

shopping_list.name: Shopping list
shopping_list.description: To-do list to use. Default: the list chosen in the integration settings.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Make this the planned recipe (shown in sensor 'Planned recipe'). Default: on.

plan.name: Plan recipe
plan.description: Make a recipe the planned recipe, for example to show its steps on a kitchen dashboard.

title.name: Title
title.description: Name of the recipe (a unique part of the name is enough).

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Scale the amounts to this number of people.

clear_plan.name: Clear planned recipe
clear_plan.description: Clear the planned recipe (for example after dinner).
